name: fleet-trellis-version-drift
title: Fleet Trellis version drift: 8 consumers seven patch releases behind
description: Split out of 08-08-fleet-one-path on 2026-08-17. Every fleet consumer runs Trellis 0.6.7 while the pack source repository vendors 0.6.14, and a thin consumer's fleet status row prints its pack pin instead of an installed-versus-target pair, so the drift is invisible in the human report and readable only at repositories[].report.versions.trellis in the JSON. Needs one upgrade PR per consumer, separate from the pack refresh PR so each leg reverts independently, plus a per-consumer ledger and a decision about whether the status row should surface the version at all.
